title: What is Gauge?
summary: Gauge - Show up in more AI answers.
body_markdown:
### ⚠️ Why should you care about AI brand visibility?


- Google searches are falling for the first time ever (and Google itself is moving to AI answers)
- Gartner predicts AI chatbots will capture 25% of search volume by next year


With traffic leaving search, traditional SEO is dying. Our customers are seeing inbound AI traffic **double every quarter** .


### 💡How does Gauge help?


We measure how often you and your competitors are[referenced and cited by AI](https://www.withgauge.com/ai-visibility) , then turn those insights into[content and actions](https://www.withgauge.com/features/content-engine) that close the gap — and measure whether it worked. See our docs for a step-by-step guide on[how to improve your AI visibility](https://docs.withgauge.com/introduction/how-to-improve-ai-visibility) .


Let’s take a look at how this works:


We came across this problem through an Open Source Day hosted by YC. There, we heard from a huge range of speakers, including Vercel, Elastic, Resend, and Airbyte. A consistent theme across every speaker was the new inbound they were seeing from ChatGPT.


We decided to run an experiment:[productrank.ai](https://productrank.ai/) .


[productrank.ai](https://productrank.ai/) lets you search for a topic, and see how the top models rank them.[Check it out here](https://productrank.ai/) !


In just a few weeks, we reached the front page of HN, saw over 40,000 organic users, and found our first design partners.


Our early customers include LendingTree, ChartHop, Resend, Helius,[Standard Metrics](https://www.withgauge.com/blog/standard-metrics-doubled-their-ai-visibility) , and more. If you’re curious in how often AI mentions your brand,[grab 15 minutes here and we’ll show you.](https://cal.com/team/gauge/demo)
